task_title: Contain Floor 2 den bosses before relocking doors

plan_review.notes: Chosen containment design retained. Resolved: encounter start now refuses to relock when the referenced boss is missing or lacks Enemy/Health; added a stale-boss regression. Added a separate unstick regression for the nearest-passable-outside-den fallback. Recorded spawn positions are already used only after den containment; the fallback remains deterministic. Added explicit bossEntityExists telemetry to distinguish missing from defeated.
